object_description: Autonomous square volume with a centralized service core
design_condition: The square volume fails to establish a fruitful dialogue with its context, while new planting, a greened street, and a large water body connect and define the surrounding open space.

positive.statement: The clear intention to connect the existing river greenery with the school greenery is appreciated.

position.target: river greenery and school greenery connection
position.rationale: Landscape connection is approximated along the southern open-space boundary.

positive.statement: The large body of water positively defines the new limit and benefits the environmental aspects.

position.rationale: Water body is placed at the exterior southern limit of the square volume.

negative.statement: The strong formal autonomy ultimately fails to enter into a fruitful dialogue with the context.

position.rationale: Square footprint and vertically autonomous volume are clearly visible across all calibrated views.

negative.statement: The organization of the square plan suffers from the centrally occupied core and hotel-like corridors.

position.target: central service core and hotel-like corridors
position.rationale: Central organization is anchored near the corroborated plan center.

negative.statement: The lack of greenery inside the citadel raises questions about use during the hottest periods.

position.rationale: Interior planting is approximated within the enclosed square footprint.

negative.statement: The structure is elaborate and its changing walls, pillars, cantilevers, and tapering lack a clear relationship with the architectural concept.

position.target: changing walls, pillars, cantilevers, and tapering
position.rationale: Cantilevered and tapered ground conditions are visibly concentrated at the lower volume.

negative.statement: The significant glazing on all orientations must be verified because it is critical to achieving the expected energy standard.

position.rationale: Repeated vertical facade bands appear on each calibrated elevation.

negative.statement: The proposed treatment of existing walls erases their tactile and visual qualities and uses a material considered too fragile for the intended use.

position.rationale: Existing wall treatment is approximated at the perimeter wall surfaces.
